notes.status: All templates are APPROVED by WhatsApp
notes.templates_are_text_only: true = do not send image/text VARIABLES in the header. Pair body-only Meta templates with per-template omit_empty_header_component=true.
notes.send_empty_header_component: When true: send {"type":"header","parameters":[]} for templates that do NOT set omit_empty_header_component (e.g. reminder_24h if Meta has fixed header / Monty requires it). Body-only templates in Meta must set omit_empty_header_component true or Monty returns Invalid HEADER.
notes.legacy_internal_ids: thank_you_message_sent_after_session: Meta name = config key; legacy post_session_feedback. sent_17_days_after_last_session_new: legacy twenty_day_followup, one_month_followup. sent_for_pause (legacy missed_paused_appointment, missed_this_month). session_feedback (legacy attended_yesterday). missed_yesterday -> sent_day_after_missed_appointment. whatsapp_lead_no_booking: 0 vars.
notes.if_monty_still_says_header_required: The template NAME or LANGUAGE in the outbound log likely does not match the text-only template in Meta (wrong namespace). Fix name in montymobile_templates.json or create a matching template in Manager; do not add fake headers.
notes.meta_template_name: Optional: meta_template_name or whatsapp_template_name overrides outbound template name. If Monty body count errors, ensure this matches the exact template name in Manager (wrong name = wrong schema).
notes.omit_empty_header_component: Per template: when true with templates_are_text_only, do NOT send {"header", parameters:[]} even if api_config.send_empty_header_component is true. Use for pure body-only Meta templates; if Monty says header required, set false or remove key.
notes.why_three_templates_failed_before: Monty HTTP 500 when body parameter count != Meta {{1}}..{{n}}. session_feedback = 1 var. sent_17_days_after_last_session_new = 3 vars. sent_day_after_missed_appointment = 1 var. sent_for_pause = 1 var. whatsapp_lead_no_booking = 0 vars.
notes.body_variable_counts: thank_you_message_sent_after_session: customer_name only. session_feedback: customer_name only. sent_17_days_after_last_session_new: customer_name, branch_name, service_name. sent_day_after_missed_appointment (missed_yesterday): customer_name only. sent_for_pause: customer_name only. whatsapp_lead_no_booking: 0. Set meta_template_name when Meta name != internal name.
notes.monty_ids: After creating new templates in Monty, paste wa_message_id and record_guid from their dashboard into each template block if your integration requires them.
